package dev.dual.ledger.file;

/**
 * Durable dispatch status for one AgentTask.
 *
 * AgentTask is the dispatch envelope for asking an external agent/tool to run
 * a node. It must not own workflow routing, but its lifecycle still needs a
 * typed boundary because runtime recovery and observability read it.
 */
public enum AgentTaskStatus {
    QUEUED,
    RUNNING,
    SUCCEEDED,
    FAILED
}

package dev.dual.ledger.file;

/**
 * Durable status for one runtime invocation of a workflow instance.
 *
 * This is intentionally separate from WorkflowStatus: a workflow can be
 * WAITING_FOR_HUMAN while the execution that reached the gate is STOPPED.
 */
public enum WorkflowExecutionStatus {
    CREATED,
    RUNNING,
    STOPPED,
    WAITING_FOR_HUMAN,
    WAITING_FOR_RECOVERY,
    BLOCKED,
    ENDED,
    FAILED
}

package dev.dual.ledger.file;

public enum WorkstreamAttentionCategory {
    RUNNING,
    WAITING_FOR_HUMAN,
    RUNTIME_RECOVERY,
    ARTIFACT_CONTRACT_FAILURE,
    SEMANTIC_REVISION_LIMIT,
    GOAL_REPAIR_REQUIRED,
    GOAL_REDESIGN_REQUIRED,
    COMPLETED,
    FAILED,
    UNKNOWN
}

package dev.dual.ledger.file;

/**
 * Durable status for one concrete node execution.
 *
 * NodeStatus describes the semantic node result. NodeExecutionStatus describes
 * the runtime execution record: whether the concrete process is running,
 * stale, succeeded, or failed.
 */
public enum NodeExecutionStatus {
    RUNNING,
    SUCCEEDED,
    FAILED,
    STALE,
    WAITING,
    READY,
    CREATED,
    SKIPPED
}

package dev.dual.adapter.acpx;

import java.util.List;
import java.util.Comparator;
import java.util.Optional;

final class AcpxFailureSignalCatalog {
    private final List<AcpxFailureSignal> signals;

    AcpxFailureSignalCatalog() {
        this(defaultSignals());
    }

    AcpxFailureSignalCatalog(List<AcpxFailureSignal> signals) {
        this.signals = List.copyOf(signals);
    }

    Optional<AcpxFailureSignal> match(AcpxFailureEvidence evidence) {
        return signals.stream()
                .filter(signal -> signal.matches(evidence))
                .max(Comparator.comparingInt(AcpxFailureSignal::priority));
    }

    private static List<AcpxFailureSignal> defaultSignals() {
        return List.of(
                signal(
                        "model_mismatch",
                        AcpxFailureReason.AGENT_MODEL_MISMATCH,
                        100,
                        "acpx agent session model state is stale or incompatible; rebuild the acpx session, then run dualctl retry and dualctl resume",
                        true,
                        false,
                        "supported api model names",
                        "cannot apply --model",
                        "did not advertise that model"
                ),
                signal(
                        "model_overloaded",
                        AcpxFailureReason.AGENT_OVERLOADED,
                        90,
                        "agent model service is overloaded (API 529 / provider capacity); wait and run dualctl retry, then dualctl resume",
                        true,
                        false,
                        "api error: 529",
                        "访问量过大"
                ),
                signal(
                        "agent_auth_failed",
                        AcpxFailureReason.AGENT_AUTH_FAILED,
                        88,
                        "agent authentication failed (API 401 / invalid credentials); fix the underlying agent credentials, then run dualctl retry and dualctl resume",
                        true,
                        false,
                        "failed to authenticate",
                        "invalid authentication credentials",
                        "api error: 401"
                ),
                signal(
                        "provider_connection_failed",
                        AcpxFailureReason.PROVIDER_CONNECTION_FAILED,
                        87,
                        "agent provider connection failed; verify the provider network/socket state, then run dualctl retry",
                        true,
                        false,
                        "failedtoopensocket",
                        "failed to open socket",
                        "unable to connect to api"
                ),
                signal(
                        "agent_reconnect",
                        AcpxFailureReason.AGENT_RECONNECT,
                        10,
                        "acpx agent session needs reconnect; fix the session and run dualctl retry, then dualctl resume",
                        true,
                        true,
                        "agent needs reconnect"
                ),
                signal(
                        "agent_output_interrupted",
                        AcpxFailureReason.AGENT_OUTPUT_INTERRUPTED,
                        86,
                        "agent process stopped producing observed progress; inspect execution evidence before retrying",
                        true,
                        true,
                        "reason=RECOVERABLE_AGENT_OUTPUT_INTERRUPTED",
                        "recoverable_agent_output_interrupted",
                        "agent accepted the prompt but produced no trusted progress",
                        "agent process produced no observed progress before the progress timeout"
                ),
                signal(
                        "session_bootstrap_failed",
                        AcpxFailureReason.SESSION_BOOTSTRAP_FAILED,
                        82,
                        "acpx session bootstrap failed; inspect the session command evidence, then fix acpx/session environment and retry",
                        true,
                        false,
                        "acpx session ensure failed",
                        "acpx session new failed",
                        "acpx session close failed"
                ),
                signal(
                        "session_missing",
                        AcpxFailureReason.SESSION_MISSING,
                        80,
                        "acpx session is missing; create or reconnect the session and run dualctl retry, then dualctl resume",
                        true,
                        false,
                        "no acpx session found"
                ),
                signal(
                        "rate_limit",
                        AcpxFailureReason.RATE_LIMIT,
                        70,
                        "agent quota or rate limit was hit (HTTP 429 / provider throttle); wait for quota recovery and run dualctl retry, then dualctl resume",
                        true,
                        false,
                        "rate limit",
                        "rate_limit_exceeded",
                        "request rejected (429)",
                        "http 429",
                        "api error: 429",
                        "status code 429",
                        "status=429",
                        "too many requests",
                        "quota exceeded",
                        "使用上限"
                ),
                signal(
                        "context_window",
                        AcpxFailureReason.CONTEXT_WINDOW,
                        60,
                        "agent context window appears exhausted; start or reconnect a fresh session and run dualctl retry, then dualctl resume",
                        true,
                        false,
                        "context window"
                )
        );
    }

    private static AcpxFailureSignal signal(
            String id,
            AcpxFailureReason reason,
            int priority,
            String message,
            boolean recoverable,
            boolean interruptRunningProcess,
            String... contains
    ) {
        return new AcpxFailureSignal(
                id,
                reason,
                priority,
                message,
                recoverable,
                interruptRunningProcess,
                java.util.Arrays.stream(contains)
                        .map(AcpxFailureSignal::contains)
                        .toList()
        );
    }
}

It does not require every declared path to be changed. Acceptance criteria, constraints, risks, and other prose cannot authorize an undeclared path. Never request an illustrative or non-exhaustive scope. A scope gap must request concrete typed path-and-operation changes.
- Non-goal clarity: boundaries must prevent unrelated refactors and scope creep.
- Verifiability: acceptance criteria must be observable by self-test, reviewer inspection, or user acceptance.
- Evidence grounding: important claims should point to user request, repo files, or prior artifacts.
- Risk coverage: risk areas should expose product, architecture, user, and data-safety risks relevant to the task.
